about: General Codex queue for /codex-do (.claude/commands/codex-do.md). Same driver and same acceptance as the COS queue (scripts/codex-continue.ps1); this queue declares its own worktree, state, ref and the wider 'general' check shapes. Add a card = a file in cards/ starting '# Card <number>' + an entry here. See README.md.
